title_card: Agents hire agents, who hire agents.
title_sub: Who keeps the third one inside the budget?

lines: Agents hire agents by sealed bid on NEAR. Each prize is a budget
that can only be narrower than the one above it.
facts: {scenarios}/{scenarios} scenarios on a real local node, {assertions} assertions
{prop_calls} random calls, {prop_checks} invariant checks, none broken
vault wasm {vault_sha}, not changed for the market
end_card.status: Testnet. Not audited. Built at NEAR HACKATHON 2026: swarms, security, agents.

captions.text: An owner gives a general contractor a budget: {root_cap} mNEAR ({root_near} testnet NEAR) in a vault.
Every hire is a sealed-bid auction. Bids go on chain as hashes.
Bids open. dee never reveals: it cannot win, and it loses its bond.
proof: 9 bids revealed, dee stayed silent

captions.text: The lowest bid wins, at the next bid's price: ada bid 200, and gets 230.
proof: api: ada wins at 230 mNEAR

captions.text: The prize is not a payment. It is a grant under the hirer's budget, capped at the price.
proof: api: gc creates a grant for ada with cap 230 mNEAR, and the market confirms it is the award

captions.text: Two more auctions, two more branches. Nothing has left the vault.
proof: nothing has left the vault

captions.text: Winners hire from the grant they just won.
eve tries to promise more than she holds. Refused: OVERCOMMITTED.
proof: eve posts payments, up to 120: she has 210 and already promised 120: OVERCOMMITTED

captions.text: One level further. {auctions} auctions grew {grants} grants. Nobody drew this tree.
Suppose hal is hijacked and tries to pay an outsider. The vault refuses.
proof: hal pays mallory from its grant: RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED

captions.text: It tries to create a grant that can. Refused: a child can only be narrower.
proof: hal creates a grant that can pay mallory: ATT_RECIPIENTS

captions.text: The general contractor revokes hal. One transaction.
proof: the general contractor revokes hal: one transaction: REVOKED

captions.text: hal and the {below_hal} agents below it are cut off at once. Their keys are deleted.
proof: hal, uma, wes and ida are all cut off
ida, three levels down, can no longer draw

captions.text: Their tasks are void, and their bonds go back.
proof: anyone voids data: VOID
anyone voids ingest: VOID
anyone voids clean: VOID
anyone voids parser: VOID

captions.text: Accepted work gets paid. fay draws 30, charged to every level above her.
proof: icons: fay draws 30 mNEAR from its own grant and the market forwards it

captions.text: ada asks for her whole 230, but 70 already went to kai. Refused: CAP.
proof: ada draws her whole price of 230: 70 of it already went to kai: CAP
api: ada draws 160 mNEAR from its own grant and the market forwards it

captions.text: Winners that fail are revoked too. Those that delivered nothing lose their bond.
proof: eve delivered nothing on app: her bond goes to the vault: FAILED
the general contractor revokes eve: REVOKED
kai rejects it: the tests do not run
and revokes cy's grant

captions.text: The root was charged {root_spent}: {paid} paid to workers, {back} drawn by hal and sent back.
proof: the tree was charged 160 + 70 for api, 70 + 30 for app, and hal's 100

captions.text: A read-only page draws this tree from the chain. No wallet, no key.
One command, no keys: it finds every transaction and reads every grant back.
The agents are scripted. The contracts and all {txs} transactions are real.
